policyBoundary.producer: typed fact or domain result only
policyBoundary.centralPolicy: fact/result plus context and bounded configuration to PolicyDecision

excludedActions.BLOCK_PR: FAIL_BUILD of a required check already blocks the PR

severityModel: OMITTED: action and retryability fully determine behavior and precedence
failOpenPrinciple: Only an unavailable optimization input may choose RUN_FULL_SUITE, and only when the trusted checkout, complete ordinary test target, and execution environment remain usable.
failClosedPrinciple: Choose FAIL_BUILD for stale eligibility, security/configuration failures, integrity violations, mapping incompleteness, required revision ambiguity, or compromised full execution correctness.
baseOutOfDateDecision: FAIL_BUILD; require PR update/rebase; never convert to FULL_SUITE
selectorFullSuiteDecision: RUN_FULL_SUITE by pass-through acceptance of the existing safe selector domain result

missingMapDecision.currentGap: bare NOT_FOUND cannot distinguish these cases

credentialPolicy: All credential, authentication, and authorization failures default to FAIL_BUILD and AFTER_USER_FIX; silent full-suite fallback is forbidden.
mappingPolicy: Incomplete, inconsistent, wrong-revision, invalid, or conflicting mapping/publication fails that mapping operation; it does not invalidate an independently validated older map.
scmPolicy: Optional automatic optimization failures run full suite only with explicit proof full execution remains trustworthy; explicit/required contexts and compromised identity fail.
inventoryPolicy: Unavailable automatic source-head inventory can run full suite; invalid, duplicate, wrong-revision, or moved-HEAD inventory fails closed.
aggregation: Evaluate the complete fact set for one operation and select the strongest decision deterministically; do not combine independent operations globally.
unknownDefault: Never allow selective execution. RUN_FULL_SUITE only in optimization-only lookup/selection contexts with explicit trusted full-suite proof; otherwise FAIL_BUILD.
hardSafetyRules: never selectively execute from corrupt, incomplete, unknown, or wrong-revision data
never convert BASE_OUT_OF_DATE to full suite
never silently hide credential, authorization, configuration, or integrity failure
unknown facts never enable SELECTED or NONE

policyInputGaps.gap: FILE versus RAW public error parity
policyInputGaps.minimumFutureChange: structured subprocess result or wrapper classification

blockingGaps: lookup absence provenance: distinguish no pointer from dangling target before executable bare-NOT_FOUND policy
implementationLocationRecommendation: Policy model and engine in smart-test-picker-common; Jenkins-only fact adapters and action realization in the companion plugin.

tests.mappingRuntime: NOT NEEDED: no production or mapping-runtime code changed
